newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket: Lara top scores for West Indies v Chairman's XI.
newsitem.headline: Cricket: Lara top scores for West Indies v Chairman's XI.

text.p: World record-holding batsman Brian Lara hit a sparkling innings of 66 as West Indies reached 256 for nine in a limited overs match against the Australian Cricket Board Chairman's XI at Lilac Hill on Monday.

Lara's innings came from 65 balls and included eight boundaries and a six as the West Indians opened their tour of Australia in confident style against an amalgam of past Australian greats and emerging players.
Lara was bowled by former Australia captain Allan Border, while Brendon Julian captured three wickets.
The Chairman's XI featured long-time pace partners Dennis Lillee and Jeff Thompson, with Lillee trapping Courtney Browne leg before wicket for 23.
